profile.address: 120 East Van Buren Street, Phoenix, AZ 85004
profile.reading:
QTS Phoenix 1, which the company codes PHX1, occupies 288,000 square feet at 120 East Van Buren Street in downtown Phoenix, of which 108,000 square feet is raised floor. QTS gives the site 32 MW of utility power capacity. QTS does not own the building: 120 East Van Buren is the Phoenix carrier hotel, owned by Digital Realty, and several operators lease space in it, LightEdge and AIS among them. QTS came by the operation through its acquisition of Carpathia Hosting in 2015.

The distinction QTS draws in its own datasheet is worth keeping. Thirty-two megawatts is the utility service the building can draw, not the IT load its customers run, and the two are not the same number. Directories that list 32 MW as this facility capacity are repeating the utility figure without the qualifier. QTS publishes no IT load for PHX1, so this registry records none.

The electrical plant is described in more detail than most operators offer. There are seventeen generator positions, of which nine hold generators of various sizes and eight are sited and available for more. Bulk diesel storage runs to 10,500 gallons with 80,000 gallons permitted and sited, and there is space set aside for tenants to install their own generators, fuel and UPS. Cooling is two 1,000-ton towers with a third position sited. That pattern, capacity present but deliberately unfilled, is what a carrier-hotel operator builds when it expects tenants to arrive with their own requirements.

For accelerator computing this is a connectivity site rather than a capacity site. A downtown retrofit sharing a building with other operators is not where a large training cluster goes; the value here is that 120 East Van Buren is the best connected building in Phoenix, which matters for inference close to users and for interconnection between networks. QTS own large Phoenix capacity is four miles east on the 40th Street campus, which the company has said will reach beyond 280 MW across five buildings.

profile.capacity_note: QTS states 32 MW as UTILITY POWER CAPACITY, which is the service the building can draw, not the IT load it carries. No IT capacity figure is published for PHX1, and directories that print 32 MW as capacity are repeating the utility figure. profile.facility_note: PHX1 is a suite operation inside 120 East Van Buren, the Phoenix carrier hotel, which Digital Realty owns and where several operators including LightEdge and AIS also lease. Its value to a tenant is the connectivity of the building rather than the scale of the hall.
profile.research_note: [2026-09-05, Claude] Created as a separate row after finding the PHX1 address attached to the wrong building. osm:way/1132632705 carried this address but sits 4.41 miles away and 0.17 miles from 1200 North 40th Street, so it is PHX2; that row has been corrected. PHX1 is a leased suite inside a Digital Realty building and is not separately mapped in OpenStreetMap, hence the operator identifier scheme rather than an osm way id. Figures are from the QTS data sheet, not from a directory: the datasheet says 288,000 sq ft facility, 108,000 sq ft raised floor, 32 MW utility power capacity, 17 generator positions with 9 installed. Directory listings variously give 113,000 and 288,000 sq ft for this site; the 113,000 figure is not on the QTS sheet and is not stored.
profile.building_owner: Digital Realty. QTS leases space in the building rather than owning it.
